rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: BTC pulled back below $60k (from ~$61.8k) into a critical support zone (~$59-60k) on thin, risk-off July 4th holiday-weekend positioning. Macro backdrop stays constructive: a weak US jobs report has shifted odds toward a Fed hold, and Fear & Greed remains near extreme fear — a defined-risk retest of support rather than chasing a stretched high.
positions.driver: On a low-edge, risk-off day the strategy favors the most liquid major with the cleanest definable stop. ETH's Glamsterdam catalyst is vague (H2 2026) and SOL's on-chain is deteriorating (monthly active users at a 2-year low, TVL -56% from the Aug-2025 peak, fees -50% since Jan), leaving both higher-beta with weaker fundamentals. Buying BTC on the support retest with an 8% stop is the best asymmetric downside-protected setup. Entry marked to a live quote at run time.
positions.risks: Support failure — a decisive break under ~$59k opens a slide toward the June ~$58k lows and would trip the stop; a hawkish surprise at the Jul 28-29 Fed; continued altseason rotation leaving BTC to lag. PRICE SOURCE NOTE: dashboard proxy feed was stale (asOf 24h old) and CoinGecko was unreachable at run time; entry/exit taken from Coinbase live spot (BTC $59,977.99) as the canonical fallback.
